matching_methods: Exact copied public methods; no matching thresholds, branch rules or normalization changed.
input_adapter: run_one.py creates each method's expected input layout from exact hash-bound public files; selects original/current symbols, fixed source snapshot and fresh static-reference addresses.
fees_annotations: Empty selected-object annotation list on both sides; all instructions and relocations retain their original algorithm. Prior bounded objects retained in history, current explicit admission/static proofs externally pinned.
fees_symbol_supplement: All raw ELF symbol-table rows decoded with the same standard ELF64 fields already used by AMM enrichment. Adds inventory only, not matching evidence.
pump_adapter: The separately sealed public Pump full_inventory.py and reviewed layer_inventory.py adapter are reused unchanged; the full paired ledger is recomputed and compared exactly.
candidate_associations: Symbol-stem matches are explicitly alternatives and do not name original functions.
